title: Household heating, two dwellings
summary: Flow, return and room temperatures with outdoor weather, and boiler state where it was recorded, over a heating year.
noRelease: No public release yet · identifiers and location being removed
limits: Thermal series only: flow, return, room and outdoor temperatures, boiler state where recorded. Identifiers stripped. Location coarsened to about 10 km and weather refetched at that point. No phone, person or zone entities. Supplier consumption daily, not half-hourly, so occupancy isn’t readable.
The second dwelling is released only with its household’s consent.
Captures never enter the repository. A manifest names the columns a release may contain; a script builds the public files from it.
revisions: v1 · first release, after the write-up.
